Google News RSS links (CBM-prefixed encoded redirects) do not follow to source via simple curl + UA spoof — they return the Google News shell page rather than the underlying article. Pipeline currently has no resolver for these. As a consequence many high-authority body-tier wires (Reuters, AP, Guardian, Washington Examiner) are unreachable for body fetch even though their RSS metadata still scores them in the cluster. Recommend either (a) adding a GN-URL decoder that follows the protobuf-encoded redirect via the news.google.com/articles JSDOM POST endpoint, or (b) supplementing sources.json with more direct-URL outlets per category (esp. Markets/Politics).
